The root manifest comment describes only the two web sites and omits the other production and test surfaces.
ATP SDK types retain the foreign Stream implementations and now have source-authored owned Stream implementations, but compile, downstream ergonomics and behavioral parity evidence remain unexecuted.
The ADR census drifted from roughly 796 references in 148 src files to 817 references in 150 src files at the A1 baseline.
The ADR calls future::join_all consumed, but it is comment-only and absent from futures-lite 2.6.1; future::or is consumed but omitted.
The ATP Stream impls now register the latest sender wake without self-waking and source-author focused wake/cancellation tests, but those inline behavior tests lack a terminal execution receipt.

fuzz targets contain two stale futures-lite comments but no direct futures-lite call or manifest edge.

The safe blocking kernel's fourteen behavioral cases passed, including the deterministic bounded notification state model, real cross-thread wake and cancellation cases, and LabRuntime quiescence. The bead required loom or a state model where applicable, not both; no exhaustive CPU-interleaving claim is made.

The policy conservatively refuses both Asupersync runtime drivers and scheduler workers, while admitting foreign executors only for self-contained futures that do not depend on the paused outer executor; the focused policy cases passed.

RCH build 29967986903220250 measured zero process CPU ticks for both implementations during separate 750 ms idle waits. Across seven alternating 50,000-call ready batches, owned median latency was 6,755,423 ns versus 1,941,878 ns incumbent; the result is recorded without a performance-parity claim.
The nine source-authored helper cases, including the bounded readiness matrix and LabRuntime/DPOR scenario, have no terminal focused execution receipt or independent differential evidence.

A raw generic Future exposes no cancellation acknowledgement, obligation ledger, or drain protocol, so a drop-only owned race cannot satisfy the project's structured loser-drain and quiescence requirement.
No deterministic fairness and trace policy replaces the incumbent race's ambient per-poll random ordering, and no expiry-independent race corpus exists.
Focused remote unit and LabRuntime execution passed for the owned poll-panic wrapper, including wake forwarding, terminal no-repoll, cleanup, and obligation quiescence.
Terminal cleanup is nested inside its own unwind boundary: a poll panic remains primary, a ready-path destructor panic becomes Err, and the inner future is removed exactly once.
Both web boundaries retain panic text only in correlated ASUP-E502 server diagnostics and return sanitized 500 responses; their Response-only API boundary intentionally produces no Outcome value.

A direct ErrorHandlerMiddleware handler-boundary test under explicit panic=unwind admission passed for poll-panic containment, exact-once future drop, a redacted ASUP-E502 response, and correlated structured diagnostics; it does not exercise a listener, router, or transport.
